items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Robin Williams told me once, he said he got a saxophone and he was trying to play and he sound so horrible.

ctx.x: I never tried misuse my instrument. This guy said... Robin Williams told me once, he said he got a saxophone and he was trying to play and he sound so horrible. He said... he was at a session and some black guy came over to him and said "Don't hurt it."
